--- text
|first line
second line
--- keys
Down
--- expect
first line
|second line
--- note
The two text lines are joined by a CRLF (carriage return then line feed), not a bare LF. The editor sets no lineSeparator, so CodeMirror treats CRLF, a lone CR, and LF alike as one line break and keeps only LF in the stored text. Down from column 0 of line 1 must land on column 0 of line 2, and the reported document must show a single newline with no carriage return. A surviving CR, or the pair counted as two stops, would fail here.
